author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.89 shipped: EC reserve oracle phase 2 + Halo NM panel channel (off) + one ack clears all CRITICALs
summary: EC reserve oracle phase 2 + Halo NM panel channel (off) + one ack clears all CRITICALs
why: Envoy: enphase_ev cloud reserve goes stale for hours and silently drops same-value writes (upstream #960), so URA trusted a wrong oracle: 15/15 CRITICAL pages false, 102/66 identical re-sends, 4.5h stuck 98% reserve importing 6kW. Chose native Envoy reserve as trusted witness (stream tier NO-GO by D0 probe) over waiting for upstream. Tier 3: D re-reviews caught 4 HIGH (post-restart 80->50 lowering twice; nudge/EVSE-overlay breaking the watchdog ladder) — fixed with anchored tests; orchestrator re-mutated both sites. Full suite caught a test-shim AttributeError silently skipping a ledger stamp. Halo ships dark (switch off); review C found 47 untested sites, now anchored. NM ack: operator flagged that slot-only ack (v5.103.88) left old CRITICALs needing repeated acks; one ack now clears all, but review caught that a plain 'ack' text would clear security alerts without authority, and a late cutoff could swallow a concurrent smoke alert — both gated/fixed.
implications: Shipped EC-ENPHASE-CONNECTIVITY-RESILIENCE-1, WALLPANEL-URA-NOTIFY-1, NM-MULTI-ALERT-TRACKING-1 at v5.103.89; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.89.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: 7-day notification_log: zero energy envoy_write_verification CRITICAL rows while native reserve sensor matched desire; reserve_write rows show no identical value re-sent inside 900s; after first button ack, zero unacked CRITICAL rows

refs.release_notes: Envoy: trusted local reserve witness, resend gap, nudge for silently-dropped writes, CLOUD_STALE instead of false CRITICAL, 45-min enforced-mismatch HIGH. Halo S1b: switch.ura_nm_panel_channel (default off) + lease TTL number. NM: one authorized ack clears every outstanding CRITICAL. See docs/readmes/README_v5.103.89.md
